posts.title: Taking over 60k spyware user accounts with SQL injection
posts.description: Background Recently I was looking through a database of known stalkerware services and found one I wasn’t familiar with: Catwatchful . It seemed to be a full-featured Android spy app, to actually be its own service as opposed to a millionth FlexiSpy reseller, and to offer a 3-day free trial.
